ann_defaults_v0_6_0.methodology: Per-tier (10K, 100K, 1M-if-cached): rebuild the ANN index in memory under two scenarios — 'fresh_install' = IndexConfig::default() with pq_subspaces=dims/4 and ANN-1.1 query-time auto formulas; 'upgrade_path' = explicit (pq=dims/8, n_probe=8, n_rerank=64) to simulate a v0.5.x-built index; ANN-1.1's legacy-sentinel detection substitutes the new auto formulas at query time. 50 queries per scenario, recall@10 against exact search, mean latency per query. Index is rebuilt in memory only — cached corpus on disk is untouched. See CHANGELOG `## [Unreleased]` → ANN-1.1.

ann_recall_grid_v2.methodology: For each (corpus_size, pq_subspaces) config: rebuild the ANN index in memory (no flush — cached file keeps its default-config index), sweep n_probe as fractions of partitions {0.08, 0.16, 0.32, 0.5, 1.0} crossed with n_rerank as multiples of top_k {5, 10, 20, 50, 100}. Report mean recall@10 against exact search + mean query latency per cell. 'Knee' per config = fastest cell meeting target_recall=0.95; falls back to the highest-recall cell when the target isn't reached (= the config's ceiling).

fixture_meta.purpose: Age-spread corpus for scoring v2 measurement. Each memory carries created_at_offset_secs; the Rust harness backdates Memory.created_at / accessed_at by that amount before remember so the recency clock has something to decay. SUPERSEDED_FACT_PAIRS guarantee each 'what's the current X' query has a single unambiguous correct answer.

ranking_v2.notes: default = ScoreWeights::default() (scoring v2 shipped). similarity_only = β=γ=δ=0 baseline, kept as a permanent row per the 2026-11-06 Planner DECISION so the next release can tell if the corpus has become trivially similarity-solvable. phase6_regression = default scoring run on the pre-scoring-v2 corpus; gates hit@1 ≥ 0.5467 and MRR ≥ 0.6665 (V0 shipped − 0.02). Scoring v2 is on a new scale from the pre-v0.7.0 formula: raw scores sit on the cosine-similarity scale plus small gated bonuses; threshold-based callers need to re-check their cutoffs.

speed_v0_6_0.remeasured_note: Only the benches listed in "remeasured" were actually re-run for v0.6.1 (DUR-1 step 5 write benches on Apple M1 Pro, hardware AES, release build). speed_v0_9_0.methodology: examples/open_rss.rs on the cached 100K x 384-dim indexed corpus (target/benches/corpus_100000_384d.mnemo), release build. Each cycle opens a fresh handle, runs one top-10 recall (timed), drops the handle, then samples process RSS via `ps -o rss=`. RSS is the whole process after the drop, not a live handle. Default system allocator, no macOS malloc env switches, no pressure relief.
speed_v0_9_0.remeasured_note: Both cells measured fresh for v0.9.0 (MEM-1 close-out) after fixing the swapped gen_clustered_vectors arguments in open_rss.rs. RSS climbs about 4.7 MB per cycle until it peaks at 359 MB (roughly the first 60 cycles, estimated from the slope), then levels off (second-half slope -0.27 MB per cycle over 200 cycles): bounded allocator retention, not a per-handle leak. The 50-cycle cell ends before the plateau, so read its slope together with the 200-cycle cell. The earlier ~500 MB-per-100K-handle reading did not reproduce.

speed_v0_9_1.methodology: benches/thread.rs (Criterion, release build, --features benches), 384-dim vectors, a trivial in-process embedder returning a canned vector, so the cells measure engine cost, not a model. ingest: 1,000 ~200-byte turns into an empty thread plus the flush. render: essence(thread, 6144) over 1,000 items (700 section items across the seven sections, 300 timeline entries). about: about() plus about_essence() on a file with a manifest and 1,000 project-scope essence items.
speed_v0_9_1.remeasured_note: All three cells are new in v0.9.1 (12.7d) and measured fresh. Render and about both decrypt every live record once per call to find the essence items, so their cost grows with the file's total record count, not only with the number of essence items.

device_budget.methodology: mnemo/examples/device_budget.rs (P-0), release build. Corpora of 1K/10K/100K memories, ~300 bytes of ASCII text and a 384-dim clustered vector each, IVF+PQ index (IndexConfig::default), fast KDF, built with one flush plus build_index plus flush. Each phase runs in its own child process under /usr/bin/time -l (peak RSS). RSS from `ps -o rss=`. handle_rss_kb = RSS after open + first recall + 200 warm recalls minus RSS before open. engine_heap_bytes = Mnemo::__budget_report capacity accounting (hash maps estimated). open = median of 20 fresh Mnemo::open calls; first recall = top-10, track_access off, on each fresh handle. Writes run on a scratch copy: 20 x (remember + flush), 5 x (100 remember + flush).

library_size_bytes.note: A plain `cargo rustc --crate-type cdylib` of mnemo-engine is 16 KB: with no extern "C" exports, LTO strips the engine. These two stripped artifacts bound the real size of the engine linked into an app until MOBILE-1 adds UniFFI exports.

device_budget.remeasured_note: All new in P-0 (2026-11-07), second of two full runs on the same machine. Run-to-run noise on this laptop is large for RAM and recall at 100K: run 1 measured handle RSS 115 MB (run 2: 158 MB), first recall 28.3 ms (9.2 ms) and warm recall 27.3 ms (23.5 ms); disk, open and write figures agreed within a few percent. aarch64 Linux library size pending (needs a Linux runner).

device_budget_v0_10_0.methodology: Same harness and corpora as the P-0 `device_budget` block (examples/device_budget.rs), after PERF-1 (v0.10.0). Differences: the warm loop is 1,000 queries (P-0: 200); new phases measure the about/essence briefing and single-turn ingest (cold = first call on a fresh handle, which builds the handle caches) and raw-key open against the secure passphrase KDF. The page cache default is now 1024 pages.

device_budget_v0_11_0.methodology: Same harness and corpora as the v0.10.0 block (examples/device_budget.rs), on v0.11.0 (FMT-9: format v9 files, the default for new files; fresh v9 corpora). Differences from v8: records share packed pages and carry no vector; vectors live in an fp16 column (resident under the 96 MiB budget); catalog and index changes are written as deltas; files under 20K facts have no ANN index (exact fp16 scan); a v9 recall reranks at least 50 x top_k candidates. `record_and_vector_pages` covers both. `batch_of_100_steady_state_median_ms` is the median of 80 consecutive batches of 100 on a copy of the 100K corpus (the harness's own batch median is over 5 batches and swings 33-43 ms between runs).
